# User Profile Model

## Purpose
The User Profile Model extends the default user entity with additional profile information, such as gender.

## Key Entities
- **UserProfile**: Holds profile-specific data for a FlexiCore user.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- UserProfile
    UserProfile o-- Gender
    class UserProfile {
        +Baseclass user
        +Gender gender
        +String phoneNumber
    }
    class Gender {
        <<enumeration>>
        MALE
        FEMALE
        OTHER
    }
```
